title: Prior-art record
description: The record an OpenSpec change that adds a requirement must hold as prior-art.json: what must exist, where the author looked in our own work and outside it, a verdict and reason for every candidate found, and the decision. Every rule about the record lives here and nowhere else; src/lockstep/prior_art.py only decides which changes need one. Brian, 2026-11-17: "every cpaability/featuer shoul dhave a prior art search so that we are only buidling what we need to. that needs to be ienforced".

need.description: One sentence: what must exist after this change that does not exist now.

searched.description: Where the author looked. At least one search in our own work (place own) and at least one outside it (place outside).

items.description: One search: the place, where exactly, the query used, and what was found.

place.description: own for our own repositories, documents and tools; outside for PyPI, standards, other projects and the web.

where.description: The source searched, named so another person can repeat the search.

query.description: The words or question searched for.

found.description: What the search returned, including that it returned nothing.

candidates.description: Every existing thing found that might do the job. May be empty when the searches found nothing. Each carries a verdict; none is left undecided.

items.description: One candidate and what was decided about it.

covers.description: What of the need it already does.

misses.description: What of the need it does not do.

verdict.description: adopt: use it as it is. combine: use it together with something else. fork: copy it and change the copy. reject: do not use it. No other word is valid, so a candidate cannot be left as 'candidate' or 'not yet evaluated'.

decision.description: What the change does about the need: adopt, combine or fork a candidate, or build something new.

gap.description: What no candidate does. Required, and not empty, when the decision is build.

decided.description: The day the decision was made, as YYYY-MM-DD.

allOf.description: A decision to adopt needs a candidate whose verdict is adopt.
A decision to combine needs a candidate whose verdict is combine.
A decision to fork needs a candidate whose verdict is fork.
A decision to build needs a stated gap and every candidate rejected.
